channel.description: Recent content in Mre on Aljareeda

item.title: Morocco Is Embedding Judges in Its Embassies to Speed Up Diaspora Cases
item.description: Morocco will station liaison judges in its diplomatic missions to follow cross-border civil, family and criminal cases. Also in issue 7513: a customs reorganisation, 13,470 hectares of tribal land fixed in law, and a new dam in Safi.

item.title: Morocco Extends Free Land Registration in 29 Zones
item.description: Morocco’s Official Gazette issue 7547 extends free land registration in 29 zones, lets governors cut local-debt enforcement costs, approves the Marchica lagoon plan, and clears a cancer-care software merger with binding conditions.

item.title: Six Moroccan Lawmakers Quit in Ten Days — Constitutional Court Declares Seats Vacant
item.description: Six Moroccan MPs resigned in ten days, the Constitutional Court moved fast to fill the gap, foreign-trained doctors got new equivalency routes, and three companies were licensed to farm shrimp, oysters and fish along the coast.

item.title: EU's Carbon Border Tax Kicks In — Morocco's Fertilizer Exports First in the Crosshairs
item.description: The EU’s carbon border tax is now live and Morocco’s fertilizer exports are exposed first; plus a €100M French water loan, 17,000 km² leased for offshore oil exploration, and a state bank still unable to close its books after 13 years.

item.title: Morocco Turns Its Port Authority Into a Company — and Locks In $1.2B a Year for Regions
item.description: Ports of Morocco SA is born, regions get a 12-billion-dirham annual floor, Bank Al-Maghrib gets bank-resolution powers, and a new real-estate law shakes up how land gets developed — all from this week’s Official Gazette.

item.title: Morocco Greenlights Land for New High-Speed Rail Line to Marrakech
item.description: This week’s Official Gazette: land cleared for the Kénitra–Marrakech high-speed line, a nationwide university expansion, new refurbished-medical-device rules, and 25,000+ hectares of tribal land formally recognized.
